description: Real-data extension ablation: S&P 500 log-returns with the tail-aware loss removed (lambda_tail = 0). The gate VQC is proxied by qegm_const: sp500_ablations.json established the two as statistically indistinguishable on this dataset (tail KL 1.599 +- 0.057 vs 1.606 +- 0.064) at ~240x the compute.
